final_assessment: Five decisions. The lint's domain is the WHOLE PROJECT rather than orbit/ — three of four restated-figure defects this session were in CLAUDE.md, which no validator reads — and it closes three ways, all SOURCED: files over `git ls-files` minus DECLARED exclusions (61 today), sources over a registry file, markers by grep. The exclusions forced a principle rather than a preference: the lint reads LIVING documents, never RECORDS, because a figure in an archived change or an emit was TRUE WHEN WRITTEN and linting it would demand rewriting history to match the present — and living-versus-record is decidable by PATH, so R-crc-10 holds throughout. The residual is stated per the kind-and-method rule: an UNMARKED restatement stays invisible, so exit criterion 1 must say MARKED; the mitigation is per-source marker coverage, a record that counts rather than judges. And half (B), the payload round-trip, SPLITS into its own stage — the notable thing being WHEN: R-crc-9's first application came after two passes and 48 findings; this one fired at exploration, before anything was written. A ruling that only works in post-mortem costs a stage every time.
next_recommended: /orbit:propose rc07-artifact-lint — substantial thinking captured; ready to formalize the design (or /orbit:explore rc07-artifact-lint to keep refining)
